name: program-runtime.usage-triage
purpose: Separate bounded program-run candidates that helped an agent from those that fought or abandoned the work, using one batched classifier call.

window_days.description: Agent program rows and runs created inside the last N days; range [1, 90].

max_pairs.description: Maximum deterministic program-run pairs sent to the single classifier batch; range [1, 32].

assumptions: program-runtime is running and exposes caller identity on new declared program rows when the caller supplies it
agent-manager run/list prompt previews are a bounded transcript-match lower bound and never a complete transcript
ai-gateway serves the classify.fast role through its governed batch binding
the caller treats transcript_match and every capped reading as a lower bound
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every execution path.
Candidate selection is deterministic and completes before inference starts.
At most one batched inference call runs on any path.
No transcript body is included in the classifier corpus.
Only fought_it, abandoned, and wrong_program entries survive into the report; helped entries are dropped.

bindings.note: Declared budget and execution metadata; unavailable rows degrade the report honestly.
Bounded program-run rows provide caller identity, outcome, and measured wall time.
Prompt previews provide only a lower-bound transcript match when caller identity is absent.
Governed episode availability is recorded for the run cohort; episode bodies are never materialized.
Searches retained conversation metadata for transcript-match run ids; snippets and bodies are not copied.
Exactly one bounded classify.fast batch call.

signals.labels: Validated labels in candidate order; closed values are helped, fought_it, abandoned, and wrong_program.
signals.pairs_classified: Number of attributed program-run pairs receiving a validated label.
signals.candidates_capped: True when more candidates existed than max_pairs.
signals.attribution_basis: Closed values caller_identity or transcript_match; transcript_match is a lower bound.
signals.inference_calls: Exactly one attempted batch call, including the no-candidate sentinel and unavailable paths.
signals.cohorts: Only fought_it, abandoned, and wrong_program entries with exemplar run ids; helped is omitted.
signals.discovery_findings: wrong_program entries routed to discovery follow-up.

outputs.evidence: Bounded binding names, attribution basis, classifier provider/model, and aggregate usage.

budget.async_reason: bounded run and optional Agent Manager reads can exceed the synchronous submission bound; submit asynchronously and wait once
